summary: HomeTrust Bancshares filed an 8-K reporting a full redemption of $11,341,000 Junior Subordinated Debt Securities due 2037, with the redemption price at 100% principal plus accrued interest, set for June 15, 2026. The redemption triggers concurrent redemption of all Capital and Common Securities of Quantum Capital Statutory Trust II. This is a routine debt extinguishment, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors mentioned. No deal terms applicable; this is a standard trust-preferred security redemption, not a corporate event requiring categorization.
